scope: Timing controls only; no changes to annual cash interest, annual forecasts, share value or root models. Policy recorded before liquidity controls are calculated.

rules.known_coupon: Half annual stated coupon on each disclosed semiannual payment date while outstanding, including maturity-date payment; omit payments after maturity. No early redemption assumed. Original outstanding principal cross-checked with 2025 Note 13 for older issues.
rules.coverage: Partial source-verified bond schedule. Residual includes unmodeled bonds, municipal notes, interest-rate hedges and any difference between the fixed analyst cash-interest envelope and nominal coupon totals. It is bookkeeping allocation, not a disclosed instrument.
rules.base_control: Known coupons on stated dates plus remaining annual envelope uniformly over four quarters; hold all other base cash flows unchanged.
rules.stress_control: Known coupons on stated dates plus remaining annual envelope split equally between Q1 and Q3; hold all other concentrated-stress flows unchanged.
rules.severe_bound: Pay the whole fixed 2.6B annual interest envelope in Q1. This provides a maximum within-year cash acceleration bound, not a plausible actual contractual schedule.
rules.tax_shield: Keep financing tax benefit timing unchanged in primary controls. Also report concentrated control with annual financing tax benefit realized in Q4 as a separate analyst stress.
rules.capitalization: Use combined cash interest for liquidity. Any split of this timing between the 1.6B ordinary and 1.0B capitalized budget is proportional bookkeeping, not instrument-specific capitalized interest evidence.
rules.materiality: Report minimum economic cash and headroom against owned 20B analytical buffer. Do not describe a buffer shortfall as negative cash or covenant failure. No borrowing assumed.
